scripts.title: lucky block giver ye
scripts.script:
--// LUCKY BLOCK GIVER YE
--// Single LocalScript | Mobile-friendly UI
--// Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
--// NOTE: Server must support target UserIds.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then return end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("LuckyBlockGiverYE")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local BLUE = Color3.fromRGB(65, 145, 255)
local BG = Color3.fromRGB(20, 23, 34)
local PANEL = Color3.fromRGB(39, 44, 59)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(245, 247, 255)
local MUTED = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 200)

local function create(className, props, parent)
    local obj = Instance.new(className)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do
        obj[k] = v
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

local gui = create("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "LuckyBlockGiverYE",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
    DisplayOrder = 999
}, playerGui)

local main = create("Frame", {
    Name = "Main",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 355),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -155, 0.5, -177),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Active = true
}, gui)

create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)}, main)
create("UIStroke", {Color = BLUE, Thickness = 2}, main)

local header = create("TextButton", {
    Name = "Header",
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 48, 72),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Text = "LUCKY BLOCK GIVER YE",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 180, 255),

scripts.script:
-- Ultra Instinct: Player + Unanchored Part Dodge
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- Use a LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local DODGE_DISTANCE = 5
local PART_DODGE_DISTANCE = 3

local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN = 3
local TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX = 5

local DODGE_COOLDOWN = 0.35
local lastDodge = 0

local function findNearbyThreat(myRoot)
    -- Check nearby players
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local character = otherPlayer.Character
            local root = character
                and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = character
                and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    <= DODGE_DISTANCE then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Check nearby unanchored parts
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(
        myRoot.Position,
        PART_DODGE_DISTANCE
    )) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart")
            and not part.Anchored
            and not part:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then

            -- Ignore parts belonging to player characters
            local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
            local isCharacter = model
                and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)

            if not isCharacter then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
    local distance = math.random(
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MIN,
        TELEPORT_DISTANCE_MAX
    )

    local offset = Vector3.new(
        math.cos(angle) * distance,
        0,
        math.sin(angle) * distance
    )

    local destination = myRoot.Position + offset

    -- Find the ground at the destination
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {character}

    local result = workspace:Raycast(
        destination + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0),
        Vector3.new(0, -40, 0),
        rayParams
    )

    if result then
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            result.Position.Y + 3,
            destination.Z
        )
    else
        destination = Vector3.new(
            destination.X,
            myRoot.Position.Y,
            destination.Z
        )
    end

    character:PivotTo(
        CFrame.new(destination) * myRoot.CFrame.Rotation
    )
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if os.clock() - lastDodge < DODGE_COOLDOWN then
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local myRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not myRoot or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    if findNearbyThreat(myRoot) then
        lastDodge = os.clock()
        randomDodge(character, myRoot)
    end
end)

scripts.title: Copy button
scripts.script:
local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ts = game:GetService("TweenService")
local logs = game:GetService("LogService")

local setclip = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set)

local function getLogs(console)
    local lines = {}
    local scroller = console:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame", true)
    
    if scroller then
        for _, v in ipairs(scroller:GetDescendants()) do
            if (v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextBox")) and v.Text ~= "" then
                table.insert(lines, {
                    order = v.LayoutOrder,
                    y = v.AbsolutePosition.Y,
                    text = v.Text
                })
            end
        end
    end

    if #lines > 0 then
        table.sort(lines, function(a, b)
            if a.order ~= 0 and b.order ~= 0 and a.order ~= b.order then
                return a.order < b.order
            end
            return a.y < b.y
        end)
        local res = {}
        for i = 1, #lines do
            res[i] = lines[i].text
        end
        return table.concat(res, "\n")
    end

    local history = logs:GetLogHistory()
    local raw = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(history) do
        raw[i] = item.message
    end
    return table.concat(raw, "\n")
end

local function checkValid(btn)
    if not (btn and btn:IsA("GuiObject") and btn.Name == "Clear") then return false end
    local buttons = btn.Parent
    if not (buttons and buttons.Name == "Buttons") then return false end
    local rConsole = buttons.Parent
    if not (rConsole and rConsole.Name == "RobloxConsole") then return false end
    local console = rConsole.Parent
    return (console and console.Name == "Console")
end

local function init()
    for _, obj in ipairs(cg:GetDescendants()) do
        if checkValid(obj) then
            local buttons = obj.Parent
            local rConsole = buttons.Parent
            
            if not buttons:FindFirstChild("Copy") then
                local copy = obj:Clone()
                copy.Name = "Copy"
                
                local title = copy:FindFirstChild("Title")
                if title then title.Text = "Copy" end
                
                local layout = buttons:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
                if layout then
                    copy.LayoutOrder = obj.LayoutOrder + 1
                else
                    local w = obj.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 and (obj.AbsoluteSize.X + 8) or 65
                    copy.Position = UDim2.new(obj.Position.X.Scale, obj.Position.X.Offset + w, obj.Position.Y.Scale, obj.Position.Y.Offset)
                end
                
                local defaultColor = copy.BackgroundColor3
                local busy = false
                
                local tIn = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 175, 85)
                })
                local tOut = ts:Create(copy, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = defaultColor
                })
                
                local function handleClick()
                    if busy then return end
                    busy = true
                    
                    if setclip then
                        setclip(getLogs(rConsole))
                    end
                    
                    if title then title.Text = "Copied!" end
                    tIn:Play()
                    
                    task.delay(1, function()
                        tOut:Play()
                        if title and title.Parent then
                            title.Text = "Copy"
                        end
                        task.wait(0.35)
                        busy = false
                    end)
                end
                
                if copy:IsA("GuiButton") then
                    copy.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleClick)
                else
                    local subBtn = copy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton", true)
                    if subBtn then subBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(handleClick) end
                end
                
                copy.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                        handleClick()
                    end
                end)
                
                copy.Parent = buttons
            end
        end
    end
end

cg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
    if checkValid(desc) then
        task.wait(0.1)
        init()
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(init)
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)
